注意开头的 /æ/，嘴张开，随后轻轻带出 /əl/。: Open your mouth for /æ/, then finish gently with /əl/.

注意 /j/ 起音，以及结尾 /oʊ/ 的自然滑动。: Start clearly with /j/ and glide naturally into the final /oʊ/.
保持 /tr/ 连贯，第一音节清晰重读。: Connect /tr/ smoothly and stress the first syllable.
将重音放在 red 和 apple，保持完整句子，不漏读 a。: Stress RED and APPLE. Read the complete sentence, including a.
用于引导学生识别颜色与物品。: Help your student identify a color and an object.

让指示词与名词的数量保持一致: Match demonstratives and nouns in number.
向学生展示一个苹果。: You are showing your student one apple.
单数可数名词 apple 前需要 a，名词保持单数。This is a red: Use a before the singular countable noun apple. This is a red apple refers to one apple.
向学生展示三辆碰碰车。: You are showing your student three bumper cars.
These are 与复数名词搭配。three 表示三辆，car 需要加 s。: These are introduces plural nouns. Three means more than one, so add s to car.
指着远处的一只大象。: You are pointing to one elephant in the distance.
That is 指单个事物。elephant 是单数，且以元音音素开头，因此使用: That is refers to one thing. Elephant starts with a vowel sound, so use an.
根据主语选择合适的动词形式: Choose the verb form that matches the subject.
The elephant 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is。: The elephant is third-person singular, so the correct form of be is is.
The apples 是复数，be 动词用 are。: The apples is plural, so use are.
描述学生手里的铅笔。: Describe the pencil your student is holding.
She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时使用 has。: She is third-person singular. Use has in the present simple.
请学生找到三角形。: Ask your student to find the triangle.
情态动词 can 后接动词原形。point to 表示指向，不能加 s 或 in: Use the base form of the verb after can. Point to means indicate something; do not add s or ing.
邀请学生跟读。: Invite your student to repeat after you.
祈使句使用动词原形。Please repeat after me. 表示请跟我读: Use the base verb for an instruction. Please repeat after me asks the student to say what you say.
邀请学生一起数动物。: Invite your student to count the animals with you.
Let’s 后接动词原形，所以用 count。: Use the base form of the verb after Let’s, so count is correct.
